transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here today. What has been going on recently that brings you in to see me?

Well, I'm really only here because my friends and an urgent care doctor keep insisting that I'm way too thin and need professional help. But to be honest, I don't really see what the big problem is with my weight being this low.
How do you feel about the idea of gaining weight, and do you have a strong fear of becoming fat?

The idea of gaining weight actually panics me, and even thinking about eating something heavy like a burger makes me worry it'll stick to me overnight and make me softer. When I look in the mirror, I just zero in on my stomach or thighs, and if they don't look razor-thin, I feel like a failure who isn't disciplined.
To help me better understand your physical health, could you share your current height and weight, and how much weight you have lost recently?

To be honest, I don't really know my exact height, current weight, or how much I've actually lost lately. I don't keep track of those numbers because I just don't see my weight as a major issue that needs monitoring.
Have you noticed any physical changes like feeling constantly cold, or if you menstruate, have your periods stopped or become irregular?
I haven't really noticed feeling constantly cold or anything like that. And since I'm a guy, the question about periods doesn't really apply to me.
Since your weight has been low, have you noticed any changes in your sex drive or sexual function, such as a decrease in interest?
I haven't really thought about that, to be honest. With how busy and stressed I've been with my mural work, I haven't really noticed any changes in that area.
What specific methods do you use to keep your weight down, such as strict dieting, intense exercising, or using things like laxatives or vomiting?

I don't do any of that stuff like vomiting, laxatives, or crazy workouts. I mostly just power through the day on black coffee and maybe a granola bar at night, telling myself I'm too busy painting or too broke to buy real meals. If the guys want to get burgers, I just say I already ate so I can avoid the food and save the money.
Even if you don't know the exact numbers, have you noticed your clothes becoming extremely loose, or have you had to go down several belt loops or clothing sizes recently?

Yeah, my clothes are definitely hanging off me and my belt is on its very last hole now. But instead of worrying me, it actually makes me feel proud, like a sign of my discipline. I still catch myself thinking I could probably drop a few more pounds to get really lean.

To help me better understand if your low weight is affecting your hormones, have you noticed a significant decrease in your sexual desire or any changes in your ability to get or maintain erections lately?
I haven't really noticed or thought about my sex drive or erections lately. Honestly, I've just been too exhausted and focused on my mural work to pay any attention to that.
You mentioned that the urgent care doctor insisted you are too thin. Did they happen to measure your weight or tell you what your weight or BMI was during that visit?
I don't really remember the exact weight or BMI numbers they wrote down during that visit. I just know the doctor was very alarmed and gave me a whole lecture about being dangerously underweight.
To help me understand the extent of your weight loss, do you remember what your typical weight was before your friends and the doctor started expressing concern?
I don't really remember what my exact weight was before all of this started. I've never been someone who paid much attention to the scale, so I didn't really track those numbers back then.
Compared to your usual baseline before you lost weight, would you say your interest in sex has significantly decreased or disappeared altogether?

I honestly haven't thought about it enough to compare it to how things used to be. My mind has been so consumed with the stress of my mural business and making ends meet that it just hasn't been a focus for me at all.
Have you noticed a decrease or absence in the frequency of your natural morning erections since you lost weight?
I haven't really paid attention to that, so I'm not really sure. Honestly, I've just been so exhausted and drained lately that I don't notice things like that anymore.
Even if you've been very busy, have you noticed a complete absence of any sexual thoughts, urges, or masturbation since your weight became so low?

I really haven't thought about it, so I'm not sure. My head has been completely filled with worrying about my mural business and finances, and I've just been too exhausted to notice anything like that.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with the core psychological and behavioral features of anorexia nervosa, including severe self-induced dietary restriction, significant weight loss, an intense fear of gaining weight, and body image distortion. However, he does not report or confirm the loss of sexual interest or potency (the male equivalent of the required endocrine disorder criterion in ICD-10 F50.0). Because this key criterion is not met, the diagnosis of Atypical Anorexia Nervosa (F50.1) is most appropriate.
